title: Jim Semivan's 7-hour briefing at the CIA

tellings.quote: the 7-hour briefing. They tell him, these high level guys tell him, "Get a room in the CIA for 6 to8 hours.

plain: Jim Semivan, a man who worked at the CIA, is said to have been told by senior officials to book a room inside the agency for six to eight hours so they could give him a briefing that lasted about seven hours. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes this on as something Semivan told about. It would mean the CIA holds a large body of UFO knowledge, shared in private with chosen insiders.
